jobs.description: Load the broker sign-up roster (root ADR-0550 §2): pin the current snapshots of silver.real_estate_broker_office and silver.real_estate_broker_member, take the offices with a Silver row at or after the last load's watermark (every office on the first load, the declared exception), read their current rows by the contracts' newest-per-key rule, and in one transaction retire those offices' roster rows, insert their current rows into catalog.real_estate_broker_office and catalog.real_estate_broker_member and record the load in catalog.real_estate_broker_lookup_load (`changed`); with no changed office it writes nothing (`unchanged`). foundation-api answers the Gongzzang sign-up's one-person check from it (POST /internal/real-estate-brokers/verify). Started when either broker Silver lane changed, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). A stopped run writes nothing and the next reads from the same watermark.

first_run.estimated_from: computed (root ADR-0386): the first load reads 106,429 offices and 179,124 people, a few tens of MB through the Trino CLI as unit_official_price_projection_load reads, and COPYs them; later runs read a few hundred offices; the load commits a batch of 20,000 offices at a time, so a first run stopped at its limit keeps what it committed and the next run goes on (root ADR-0457)

expected_outcome.basis: both broker Silver lanes take a new national file every day and offices change every day (root ADR-0511 §4); this job has not run yet, so its first change is its first load (root ADR-0457).

assets.title: 중개사 가입 확인 명부
assets.description: 공짱 회원 가입이 중개사 한 사람(이름 + 자격증번호 또는 사무소 등록번호)을 확인하는 비공개 명부. 두 중개업 Silver 에서 바뀐 사무소만 싣고, 덧붙이기만 한다(물린 행은 물린 적재를 든다). foundation-api 가 서비스 주체에게만 일치·불일치로 답하고 사람 목록은 내주지 않는다(루트 ADR-0550).

dependencies.description: 바뀐 사무소의 현재 행(상호·상태)을 명부에 싣는다.
바뀐 사무소의 소속 인원 전부(이름·종별·자격증번호·직위)를 명부에 싣는다.
